# Contributing

Thank you for considering contributing to this project! 🎉

## Getting Started

1. Fork this repository.
2. Clone your fork:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/huynhducthanhtuan/tuan-dat-grocery-price-tracker.git
```

3. Create a new branch:

```bash
git checkout -b feature/your-feature
```

## Making Changes

Please keep your changes:

- Small and focused.
- Easy to understand and review.
- Consistent with the existing code style.
- Properly tested when applicable.

## Commit Messages

Use clear and meaningful commit messages.

Examples:

```text
feat: add product price extraction
fix: handle invalid product URL
docs: update installation guide
refactor: improve product service
test: add product extraction tests
```

## Pull Requests

Before opening a Pull Request:

- Make sure the project builds successfully.
- Run the available tests.
- Review your changes.
- Update documentation if necessary.

Please provide a clear description of:

- What was changed.
- Why the change was needed.
- Any relevant issues or considerations.

## Issues

When creating an issue, please provide enough information to reproduce the problem.

Include:

- A clear description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce.
- Expected behavior.
- Actual behavior.
- Relevant logs or screenshots, if applicable.

## Code of Conduct

Please be respectful and constructive when participating in this project.

Thank you for contributing! ❤️
